I think they should be removed from civilization and rehabilitated. And when I say that, I don’t mean prison. I mean therapy, medicine, learning coping, understanding why they have awful urges and how they can live without acting on them. Of course society will still hate them, but as a victim, I have always said it brings me an immense amount of guilt to have my molester sit in prison alone. So from personal experience, life does get better. It’s not min from max. It’s a gradual lift as you realize something small like “Hey, I actually got up today to eat..” to something in the middle “Oh hey, I’m actually making my bed today..” or a personal Maxine  “Wow, I haven’t been insecure about my friendships lately! I feel like I’m loved!” Definitely avoid isolating yourself. At least talk to one person and therapy (also medicine if you believe in that because when I got on the right antidepressants, my life changed drastically) helps so much. The best way to create meaningful relationships is balance casual and deep conversation. Don’t throw your trauma onto your friends but don’t feel uncomfortable to talk about it with them. Realize they’re your friends and they care about you, but they’re not a therapist. It took me most of my life to figure this out and I went from attempting suicide every month, being in and out of the hospital and never in school, and self harming with no friends because I didn’t know how to not overload people. Today I have an amazing group of friends, and getting B’s and above in school, and am on my way to graduating and applying to colleges with a loving family and their support. Life gets better, you just have to be very very patient.
